review:
A busy 100-line Asian slot with lanterns, gold coins and imperial palaces. The dragon wild can expand to fill its reel and complete wins across loads of lines at once.

The lucky cat and another symbol work as scatters, and you can gamble base-game wins on a card. There's no classic free spins round here – the action comes from line hits and those expanding wilds. High volatility, a 3,000x cap and 96.07% RTP. Good if you like old-school, busy line slots.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
